mapper.select: SELECT h.Holdings_ID, h.Client_ID, h.Instrument_ID, h.Quantity_Shares, h.Purchase_Price, c.email as client_email, c.username as client_username, i.Symbol as instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name as instrument_symbol_name FROM Holdings h LEFT JOIN Clients c ON h.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON h.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID WHERE h.Holdings_ID = #{id}

SELECT h.Holdings_ID, h.Client_ID, h.Instrument_ID, h.Quantity_Shares, h.Purchase_Price, c.email as client_email, c.username as client_username, i.Symbol as instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name as instrument_symbol_name FROM Holdings h LEFT JOIN Clients c ON h.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON h.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID WHERE h.Client_ID = #{clientId} ORDER BY i.Symbol ASC

SELECT h.Holdings_ID, h.Client_ID, h.Instrument_ID, h.Quantity_Shares, h.Purchase_Price, c.email as client_email, c.username as client_username, i.Symbol as instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name as instrument_symbol_name FROM Holdings h LEFT JOIN Clients c ON h.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON h.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID WHERE h.Client_ID = #{clientId} AND h.Instrument_ID = #{instrumentId}

SELECT h.Holdings_ID, h.Client_ID, h.Instrument_ID, h.Quantity_Shares, h.Purchase_Price, c.email as client_email, c.username as client_username, i.Symbol as instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name as instrument_symbol_name FROM Holdings h LEFT JOIN Clients c ON h.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON h.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID ORDER BY c.username ASC, i.Symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Holdings (Client_ID, Instrument_ID, Quantity_Shares, Purchase_Price) VALUES (#{client.id}, #{instrument.id}, #{quantityShares}, #{purchasePrice})
